newsitem.title: USA: Embrex files patent suit against IGI.
newsitem.headline: Embrex files patent suit against IGI.

text.p: Embrex Inc on Tuesday said it has filed a patent infringement suit against IGI Inc in the U.S. District Court, Eastern District of North Carolina.
The suit claims that IGI, through its activities with Service Engineering Corp is engaging in activities that constitute infringement of it INOVOJECT injection method.
The INOVOJECT system is a proprietary, automated, in-the-egg injection system which eliminates the need for manual vaccination of newly hatched broiler chicks, Embrex said.
IGI executives were not immediately available for comment.
Embrex also alleges that Service Engineering violated the terms of a consent judgment and settlement agreement entered into with Embrex in November 1995.
